research.query: everything agent harness browser open source; headless browser agent session manager open source
research.observation: Driver session manager owns browser lifecycle and sidecar handles, clears them on close, and resets bounded retry state after success or configuration changes.
research.strength: Explicit session ownership and deterministic teardown are directly useful for Browser/Computer leases.
research.weakness: Upstream lifecycle depends on external browser/provider services and does not prove Omnia Windows packaging.
research.impact: BROWSER-001 and COMPUTER-001 should bind lease owner, teardown receipt, and retry reset to configuration identity.

research.query: open source agent context compaction RAG everything super power pro max
research.observation: Adaptive compression returns retained content, ratio, classification, rationale and token savings while preserving code-oriented content.
research.strength: Receipt fields make compaction decisions observable and auditable.
research.weakness: Token estimates and provider behavior are Python-specific and are not Omnia native runtime evidence.
research.impact: Add bounded compaction receipt fields and explicit passthrough/unavailable states before claiming context guarantees.

research.query: AI IDE open source stars:>1000; everything agent IDE
research.observation: File tree renders hierarchy from a flat path index, keeping lookup and rename behavior independent of visible depth.
research.strength: Path-indexed state supports stable project/file identity and efficient tree projection.
research.weakness: Web editor source does not prove native Windows root permissions or Omnia pointer persistence.
research.impact: IDE-001 and storage criteria should keep canonical path identity separate from tree presentation.

research.query: everything superpowers MCP server skills repository; open source MCP registry skills context memory
research.observation: Skill cards separate metadata, instructions and resources and retain immutable source/path/version/compatibility and visibility fields.
research.strength: Progressive disclosure and immutable identity reduce context pressure and enable approval gates.
research.weakness: Registry documentation does not prove Omnia MCP transport, OAuth storage or native permissions.
research.impact: MCP and skills manifests should use origin/path/revision/digest identity with lazy expansion and explicit activation approval.

research.query: open source RAG memory agent everything super power pro max
research.observation: Hybrid retrieval keeps lexical and vector arms separate, fuses candidates, reranks, applies a threshold and records arm statistics.
research.strength: Arm-level stats and bounded top-k/threshold decisions make degraded retrieval observable.
research.weakness: External embeddings and hosted answer providers are outside Omnia native proof.
research.impact: RAG receipts should include arm candidate/error counts, ranker/version, requested/returned top-k and threshold decisions.

research.query: open source AI chat UI model picker advanced settings; everything super power pro max
research.observation: Model configuration groups providers and validates model, context, compaction and memory controls through typed UI state.
research.strength: Per-session model/context controls are discoverable and validation-oriented.
research.weakness: Local picker state is not native catalog persistence or live provider evidence.
research.impact: ADVSET-003 must distinguish requested/applied/unsupported models and preserve running-attempt route identity.
